title: Guard with an early return
prompt: Dividing by zero is an error. Run the starter to see it. Then fix it: if b is 0, return -1 straight away; otherwise return a divided by b (whole-number division).
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	return a / b
hint: An if with a return inside stops the function early; the code after it only runs when the if was false.
